title: Apprentice Sales Advisor
description:
What's in it for you:
- A great starting salary of £22,527 rising to £26,738 after completion of the apprenticeship. Plus, an uncapped commission scheme.
- An NVQ Level 2 in Customer Service following the completion of the apprenticeship (15 months)
- Huge discounts off your Mobile and Broadband packages, starting at £10 a month
- Huge discounts off other tech such as Smart watches, speakers, tv's, gaming consoles and subscriptions
- Discount codes to give out to friends and family
- Support to carve your own career path. We're passionate about helping our people grow the career they want
- Season Ticket Travel Loan - giving you the funds to pay for your travel to and from work up front
- Online GP: Access to a private GP 24/7 for you and your immediate family

What you'll be doing

At EE, we believe every customer interaction should be a positive experience. You'll speak with customers over the phone, getting to know what matters most to them, building strong relationships, and recommending the right EE products and services to suit their needs. You'll use your energy and ambition to thrive and meet goals, and grow your skills along the way. From the latest mobile tech and broadband, and smart home solutions, every conversation is a chance to make a real impact and grow your confidence.

As part of your apprenticeship, you'll complete a 15-month NVQ Level 2 in Customer Service. We'll support you every step of the way - including one dedicated study day a week, guidance from a college tutor, and extra coaching to help you feel confident in your role.

Why choose EE

You don't need experience, all you need is a great attitude, a friendly voice, and the willingness to learn. We'll give you all the training you need and we're passionate about helping you kick start your career.

At EE, you're part of something bigger. You'll make friends, learn new skills, and build confidence every day. We're proud to be inclusive and welcome people from all backgrounds - because everyone belongs here.

Ready to make your mark? Apply now and let's start building your future.

title: BMW Sales Executive
description:
BMW SALES EXECUTIVE.

Earn up to £60,000 OTE per annum plus a Company Car!

WHY WORK FOR HEDIN AUTOMOTIVE BMW & MINI.

Join the Hedin Automotive sales team as a BMW Sales Executive and help customers find their perfect BMW while delivering an exceptional buying experience. You'll represent one of the world's leading premium automotive brands, guiding customers through every stage of their journey, from their initial enquiry through to vehicle handover. With access to the latest BMW models, innovative technology, and ongoing manufacturer training, you'll have everything you need to build a rewarding career in automotive sales.

BENEFITS.

Hedin Automotive values our employees and invests in personal development and training. In addition, we offer a wide range of market-leading benefits to all our colleagues.
- 31 days of annual leave (including bank holidays) with long-service awards and enhanced holiday entitlement
- Discount schemes with popular retailers - helping you save more
- Employee Car Ownership Schemes - available for you and your family
- Employee Assistance Programme - 24/7 wellbeing support with access to health professionals
- Private healthcare access - prioritising your health and prosperity
- Pension scheme and life assurance - confidence in your future
- Referral bonus - earn when you refer a friend to join the team

Why not take a moment to view all our benefits and see what our employees love about working at Hedin Automotive by visiting our

THE MAIN DUTIES OF THE ROLE INCLUDE:
- Guiding customers through the complete sales journey, from initial enquiry and test drive through to finance, accessories, and vehicle handover
- Providing expert advice across the full range of new and approved used BMW models
- Identifying customer needs and delivering tailored solutions while achieving individual sales targets
- Proactively building relationships with new and existing customers to generate repeat business and referrals
- Assisting customers with vehicle configuration, finance options, and part-exchange valuations
- Negotiating sales professionally while ensuring an outstanding customer experience
- Accurately processing sales contracts, vehicle orders, and finance documentation
- Acting as a brand ambassador for BMW and maintaining exceptional product knowledge

YOUR PROFILE.
- Strong communication, influencing, and negotiation skills to close sales
- Highly motivated with a passion for achieving and exceeding sales targets
- Enjoy following processes, handling administration, and working under pressure
- Well-organised with excellent diary management and timely follow-ups
- Skilled at building rapport, earning trust, and resolving conflicts calmly.
- Enthusiastic about customer service, professional, and well-presented
- Proven Sales experience in the automotive industry preferred.

SALARY AND WORKING HOURS.
- Basic salary of £23,000 per annum with a competitive OTE of £50,000-£60,000, with a Company Car
- Monday to Friday, 8:30am - 6pm with a day off during the week, plus every Saturday, 8:30am to 5pm (41.5 hours per week). Additionally, will be required to work Sundays on a rota basis (1 in 15).

ABOUT US.

Hedin Automotive is a well-established BMW & MINI franchise with state-of-the-art centres across North London, East London, and Kent.

As part of Hedin Mobility Group-one of the world's leading private automotive retail and aftermarket services providers we are dedicated to excellence in everything we do. Whether in customer-facing roles or the workshop, our incredible teams are passionate about making Hedin Automotive a seamless, enjoyable place to do business. We strive to create great experiences through a team that genuinely cares about our customers.

Click apply today and take the first step towards a rewarding career in the automotive industry.

title: Business Development Executive
description:
Business Development Executive

An exciting opportunity for a Business Development Executive to join a top-tier global law firm. Working closely with the BD Manager and Partners, you'll play a key role in delivering the firm's business development and marketing strategy, supporting client development initiatives, campaigns, events and profile-raising activities while building strong relationships with stakeholders across the business.

What's On Offer:
- Salary to £46,000
- 09:30-17:30 working hours and hybrid working of 50% office based per week
- Stunning offices and sought-after City location

Business Development Executive - What You'll Be Doing:

You will help drive initiatives across profile building, client retention and development, new client targeting, and sector growth.

This role offers the opportunity to collaborate with other specialist teams, including Marketing, Digital, Communications, PR, Events, CRM, Client Services, Bids, and Responsible Business. The successful candidate will focus on maintaining client relationships, preparing tailored pitch documents, ensuring accurate client data in the CRM system, and supporting the planning and delivery of sector-specific campaigns, events, and thought leadership initiatives.

Business Development Executive - What We're Looking For:

The ideal candidate must be willing to travel to other UK-based offices when required, have a minimum of 2 years' experience of broad-ranging marketing roles, preferably within the legal or real estate sectors, as well as possess a bachelor's degree in marketing, communications, or a related field.

A client focused mindset and a strong collaborator will excel in this role.

For further information, please contact Neil Hagan.

title: Business Development Executive
description:
Business Development Executive - Construction Property Professional Indemnity

Overview:

As a Business Development Executive, you will proactively engage with mid-market and SME businesses across the UK, with a particular focus on clients within the construction and property professional services sector. This includes organisations such as surveyors, architects, design and planning consultancies, and engineering firms across all disciplines. You will help clients understand how you / our client can support their insurance needs, gaining valuable experience in identifying risk exposures, discussing tailored insurance solutions, and promoting end-to-end service-from initial consultation through to long-term partnership.

Your role will be central to expanding our clients client base and supporting our mission to deliver exceptional, specialist-led insurance solutions. Whether you are advising a local professional practice or supporting the placement of more complex programmes for growing and internationally active firms, your contribution will play a key role in driving continued growth.

Responsibilities:

Proactively contact prospective clients to introduce, gather relevant insurance information, and support negotiations with both clients and insurers.

Identify, research, and develop new sources of prospective clients to help expand presence and market reach.

Work closely with brokers and account handlers to support the onboarding and development of potential new clients.

Accurately maintain client and prospect records on our CRM systems, ensuring all information is recorded promptly and kept up to date in line with company standards.

Build a strong foundation of Professional Indemnity Insurance knowledge, including working towards and achieving CII insurance qualifications.

Actively participate in structured training and development programmes focused on building the core skills required for success in the role.

Contribute as part of a fast-paced, collaborative, and continually evolving environment, with significant opportunities for learning and professional growth.

Requirements:

Previous experience within the insurance market and sales.

Excellent communication and collaboration skills. Our clients team thrives on effective communication and the ability to work together towards common goals.

Sales and negotiation skills that will help you compete in a fast-paced market.

Strong motivation and ambition in progressing your career in insurance.

An eye for detail to ensure that all records and client interactions are meticulously managed and maintained.

title: Business Development Executive
description:
Telephone / Internal Business Development Manager - Specialist Property Finance

Location: London / Hybrid (3-4 days per week office based)

£35 - £45k Basic + Bonus + Benefits (Dependent on experience)

We're looking for an office based Telephone / Internal Business Development Manager to join a leading specialist property finance lender, supporting a BDM's in a client services capacity.

You'll be the first point of contact for their broker network, onboarding new brokers, triaging inbound calls and enquiries, and ensuring every broker gets a fast, professional response, whether that's you resolving it directly or routing it to the right person on the team. This is a genuinely important relationship focused role, you'll be shaping brokers' first impressions of the business and keeping their day-to-day experience running smoothly.

This role offers genuine career progression into a full business development role.

Responsibilities:
- Onboarding new brokers and introducers, guiding them through registration, product knowledge and how best to work with us
- Acting as the first point of contact for inbound broker calls and enquiries, triaging and resolving queries or directing them to the right BDM or departments.
- Supporting a team of experienced BDM's, following up on leads, and keeping their pipelines moving.
- Building strong telephone relationships with brokers, providing product and criteria guidance where needed
- Maintaining accurate broker and case records on the CRM, ensuring the wider team has visibility of activity and status
- Identifying opportunities to support broader business development activity, including cross selling and highlighting new leads to the sales team

Experience required:
- Candidates must have experience within financial services, either as a Junior BDM, Relationship Manager, Mortgage Broker or Client Services - ideally within BTL or Bridging Finance.
- Confident, professional telephone manner with strong relationship building skills
- Highly organised, with the ability to manage multiple priorities.
- Good working knowledge of CRM systems and comfortable picking up new processes and criteria quickly
- A genuine team player who takes pride in providing an excellent broker experience

title: Business Development Executive
description:
A leading global law firm is seeking a Business Development Executive to join its London-based Marketing & Business Development team, supporting its Real Estate, Tax and Employment practices across the EMEA region.

This is an excellent opportunity for an ambitious BD professional to gain broad exposure to strategic, client-facing and profile-raising activity while working closely with partners, senior stakeholders and colleagues across the global business.

The Role

The Business Development Executive will support the delivery of business development and marketing strategies, including:
- Developing bids, pitches, credentials, presentations and client-facing content
- Supporting business plans, campaigns, client development and profile-raising initiatives
- Coordinating events, directory submissions and award entries
- Managing and maintaining marketing materials and budgets, including ROI reporting
- Building strong relationships with partners, lawyers and internal stakeholders
- Collaborating with specialist teams across BD, bids, events, design, digital and marketing services
- Sharing best practice and contributing to wider EMEA and global initiatives

About You

The ideal candidate will be a graduate-calibre BD or marketing professional with:
- Experience in business development, marketing or communications, ideally within legal or professional services
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills and strong attention to detail
- Experience writing bids, pitches or sales-focused content is advantageous
- Strong organisation and the ability to manage multiple priorities and stakeholders
- A proactive, collaborative and commercially minded approach
- Confidence to take ownership and build relationships with senior stakeholders
- A relevant professional qualification, such as CIM, is desirable

Why Join?

The role offers excellent exposure to strategic business development, partner engagement and international collaboration, providing a strong platform for career progression within a high-performing global professional services environment.

The firm is committed to diversity, inclusion, flexible working and employee wellbeing, creating an environment where people can develop, collaborate and achieve their full potential.

If this job isn't quite right for you, but you know someone who would be great at this role, why not take advantage of our referral scheme? We offer £200 in shopping vouchers for every referred candidate who we place in a role. Terms & Conditions Apply.

title: Business Development Executive 12-month FTC
company: Norton Rose Fulbright LLP - Agency - Permanent
description:
Practice Group / Department:

Business Development - ESG - London

Job Description

Norton Rose Fulbright is a global law firm with more than 3,000 lawyers advising clients across locations in the United States, Europe, Canada, Latin America, Asia, Australia, Africa and the Middle East. We provide a full scope of legal services to the world's preeminent corporations and financial institutions.

Our vision is to be a world class business, profitable, ambitious, cooperative and considerate, supporting our clients and people through our global business principles of Quality, Unity and Integrity.

With over 7,000 employees worldwide, our culture is the thread that connects us. Our strategy and culture are closed connected - defined by shared ambition, global collaboration and a one-team mindset. We believe pioneering work happens when people are empowered to think beyond boundaries, explore new opportunities and grow through diverse experiences. Alongside the right skills and experience, we are looking for people who are innovative, commercially minded, and motivated by the impact of the work they do - ready to share in our ambition and help shape what comes next.

Because while individuals can do well, together we achieve something extraordinary.

The Role

The Business Development Executive (BDE) role is a permanent role within NRF's London office in the Marketing & Business Development (MBD) function and the Europe, Middle East & Asia (EMEA) region at Norton Rose Fulbright.

The role reports to a Senior Business Development Manager responsible for strategic growth initiatives across sectors and practice areas, and will work closely with the Business Development Manager supporting the Real Estate, Tax and Employment practices.

This position offers the opportunity to develop specialist knowledge within these practice areas while also contributing to initiatives and campaigns that span multiple sectors, practices and regions. The role holder will work with a diverse range of colleagues across the firm, building a strong internal network and gaining valuable insight into how collaboration drives client relationships and business growth.

Working closely with business development managers and partners, the role holder will contribute to the delivery of the team's business development strategy. This includes supporting client development initiatives, marketing campaigns, events and profile-raising activities, while building effective relationships with stakeholders across the firm.

This is an excellent opportunity for someone developing their career in business development. The role provides exposure to a wide range of strategic and client-facing activities, regular interaction with partners and senior colleagues, and the opportunity to develop commercial awareness, relationship management and project management expertise.

The role holder will also work in close co-operation with colleagues across the global and EMEA Marketing and Business Development teams as well as our support team in Newcastle.

Key Responsibilities
- Producing bespoke bids, credentials, pitches, presentations and other client development and marketing content (formal and informal).
- Working with the relevant practice leadership and BD managers to create and implement business plans, budget proposals and campaign plans for the EMEA region.
- Assisting with all aspects of the planning, development and implementation of BD and marketing activity. This includes, but is not limited to, business development, client development, profile raising, marketing, communications, bids and event management.
- Acting as a key point of contact and ambassador for the practice.
- Establishing a close and effective relationship with the lawyers and partners within the practices.
- Working closely with other MBD teams, including the client relationship team, strategic bids, events, design and digital, and our Newcastle-based marketing services team.
- Coordinating and drafting directory and award submissions.
- Ensure marketing materials are kept up to date.
- Supporting the management of relevant MBD budgets, including reporting of ROI.
- Contributing and leading on best practice.

Key Skills and Experience
- Graduate calibre with demonstrable and/or professionally recognised BD, marketing or communications qualification (such as CIM, etc).
- Experience in marketing and business development is desirable, as is experience of working in a legal/professional services/partnership environment.
- Excellent written and oral communication skills, including strong attention to detail.
- Confident and willing to take on additional responsibility as required.
- Highly organised with a professional, confident, collaborative and proactive approach to their role.
- Ability to manage competing priorities, multiple tasks and stakeholders.
- Experience in managing and writing bids or similar sales writing is desirable.
- Understands the need, and has the ability, to manage expectations.

Diversity, Equity and Inclusion

To attract the best people, we strive to create a diverse and inclusive environment where everyone can bring their whole selves to work, have a sense of belonging, and realize their full career potential.
Our new enabled work model allows our people to have more flexibility in the way they choose to work from both the office and a remote location, while continuing to deliver the highest standards of service. We offer a range of family friendly and inclusive employment policies and provide access to programmes and services aimed at nurturing our people's health and overall wellbeing. Find more about Diversity, Equity and Inclusion here.

We are proud to be an equal opportunities employer and encourage applications from individuals who can complement our existing teams. We strive to create an inclusive and accessible recruitment process for all candidates. If you require any tailored adjustments or accommodations, please let us know here.

title: Customer Service - Sales Executive
description:

Inbound Sales Consultant

Romford Hybrid Working Available After Successful Completion of Probation

This is a role where strong performance is recognised and rewarded from day one.

As an Inbound Sales Consultant, you'll be responsible for handling customer enquiries and guiding them through the sales process.

Your day-to-day responsibilities will include:

title: Legal Sales Consultant
description:
Closing date: 23-09-2026

Sales Consultant - Legal Services
£26,500 - £30,000 base salary, OTE £45,000 plus excellent benefits (Work Level 6 B)
Monday-Friday, 37.5 hours flexible between 9am and 9pm, with 3 evenings per week, and two in four Saturdays.
Home based across England and Wales, travelling when required

For this role you'll be required to start on 9th November 2026

We're looking for people with great customer service and communication skills to join us as Sales Consultants at Co-op Life Services. Working in our Estate Planning team, you'll help clients plan for the future and look after the people who matter most to them. You don't need a background in law to do this job, as we'll provide full training and ongoing development.

Why this role matters

Planning for later life can feel daunting, so it's important that clients have access to clear, straightforward advice when they need it most. In this role, you'll help people make informed decisions with confidence, making sure our clients receive the right support while delivering a caring and accessible experience that makes a real difference to them and their families.

What you'll do
- Attend video or phone-based appointments to discuss the benefits of later life legal services with clients
- Work closely with clients to identify their different needs, providing information and solutions to best meet their requirements
- Explain legal issues to clients in an understandable way, without legal jargon
- Guide clients through their options, helping them make informed decisions on funeral plans in line with FCA regulations
- Develop positive relationships with Co-op colleagues, working together to provide the best possible client journey
- Perform to agreed targets to deliver outstanding client outcomes and commercial success
- Travel for face-to-face client or company meetings when required

What you'll bring

We're committed to making our roles as accessible as possible, so we only ask for the minimum criteria. To thrive here, you'll need to bring:
- Previous experience of B2 B or B2 C consultative sales and supporting customers to make decisions
- A full UK driving licence and access to your own vehicle
- Confidence, empathy and understanding when speaking with potential clients
- Active listening skills with the ability to adapt your communication style and engage a diverse range of clients through telephone, video, and face to face discussions
- The ability to consult and influence while showing enthusiasm for our products and services
- Excellent literacy and numeracy skills, with a high level of attention to detail and a commitment to delivering accurate work
- The ability to achieve key targets and work towards deadlines
- Good general IT skills, with the ability to quickly learn and adapt to new systems

Why Co-op?

At Co-op, we're owned by our members. And because we're owned by you, we can do right by you. So when you join us, you're not just taking a job, you're joining a movement. We're an organisation that puts people and communities first, and we're powered by purpose. We want this to be a place where you can thrive, so you'll also receive:
- A pension with up to 10% employer contributions
- An annual bonus scheme (dependent on personal and business performance.)
- 28 days holiday plus bank holidays (rising to 32 in line with service)
- 30% discount on Co-op products and 10% off other brands
- Stream - early access to a percentage of your pay as you earn it
- Virtual healthcare including GP appointments, mental health support, nutrition and fitness advice
- 24/7 colleague support service
- Coaching, training and support such as study leave, to help you develop your skills and progress your career
- Cycle-to-work scheme

A place where you'll belong

We're building diverse and inclusive teams that reflect the communities we serve. We welcome applications from everyone and are committed to creating a workplace where colleagues can feel like they belong, supported by our inclusive policies and the ways we work.

We're proud to be part of the Disability Confident scheme and offer interviews to disabled candidates who meet the minimum criteria for a job. If you need any adjustments during the recruitment process, we'll support you.

Learn more about our recruitment process at jobs.coop.co.uk/apply-process and our inclusion commitments at jobs.coop.co.uk/diversity-inclusion

If you're successful in your application, we'll perform some background checks as part of our pre-employment screening process. These will include an SRA check, credit checks, and a DBS (disclosure and barring service) check. Please note Co-op does not offer visa sponsorship for this role.

As part of the application process, you'll be asked to complete an online assessment, it will take you around 20 minutes to complete this.

title: Head of Customer Success

title: IFA Client Service Associate
company: Premier Jobs UK Limited - Agency - Permanent
description:
A national IFA firm is hiring a Client Service Associate to work remotely across their central region, handling existing client onboarding, review meetings and new business processing. Paying £28,000 to £32,000, this role suits someone who thrives in a structured, task-based environment and wants the flexibility of fully remote working from day one.

Your purpose

You'll be part of their operational thread running through the advice process, ensuring existing clients move smoothly from review through to completion. Working across a central region covering substantial number of clients, you'll handle all the paperwork involved in ongoing cases and new business, picking up work from a centralized task list rather than supporting one dedicated planner. This requires a systematic style of working where accuracy and efficiency matter.

What the job involves
- Processing existing client onboarding across the central region
- Completing all review meeting documentation and follow-up
- Handling new business cases and ongoing client work
- Preparing Letters of Authority and ensuring data accuracy
- Working through structured task lists as cases come in
- Liaising with Financial Advisers and Paraplanners to ensure they have what they need

IFA Client Service Associate Requirements
- Essential: experience in an IFA administration role with strong client onboarding knowledge
- Essential: familiarity with Letters of Authority and the advice process
- Essential: comfortable working in a centralized team across multiple planners
- Desirable: experience using IO, Curo, Cashcalc or Dynamic Planner
- Desirable: based in Scotland, though candidates elsewhere will be considered for this fully remote role

About the business

This growing national firm is led by respected industry names and backed by private equity. On track to exceed £10 billion in assets under management and continuing acquisitions, they recognize that success depends on having the right people.

IFA Client Service Associate Benefits
- Salary of £28,000 to £32,000
- 37.5 hours per week, fully remote
- 28 days holiday plus bank holidays, rising by one day per year to 30 days
- 4x death in service, private medical insurance, group income protection
- Employee assistance programme, Medicash, 8% combined pension contribution
- Discretionary annual bonus

What happens next

Your application comes to Premier Jobs UK, we reply to every candidate either way, and where the experience fits we'll call to understand what you're looking for. Apply now for this remote Client Service Associate role and take the next step in your IFA career.
